subject: Important Changes to Your Account Terms
body:
We are writing to inform you of changes to the terms and conditions that apply to your current account, effective from 1 April 2026.

The key changes are as follows. The monthly fee for accounts with a balance below £500 will increase from £5.00 to £6.50. Overseas transaction fees will be reduced from 2.99% to 2.75% of the transaction value. The interest rate on arranged overdrafts will change from 39.9% EAR to 39.9% EAR (no change).

You do not need to take any action. If you do not wish to continue under the new terms, you have the right to close or switch your account free of charge before the effective date. Full details of all changes are available on our website and in branch.
